ul.li: Initialize blank device array
Assigns device array corresponding coordinates as per the labmap layout
Populates the devices with accurate information corresponding to the real state of the computer lab, as determined by the data_generator.py

li.span: Contains functions which do the following:

ul.li: Determines which devices have users by combing through the now populated Devices array
Checks Devices array for new users
When a new user appears, spawns a Waddles who walks in and sits down at the computer, and then walks out when the user is no longer active.

li.span: When new user is found, asks art repo if user has custom sprites to use

ul.li: Rust Actix-Web server which acts as an end point which can be accesible over the web.
Runs data_generator.py everytime /generator is accessed.
Returns 401 if .env file is missing on the instance.
This server also contains endpoints for per-user configuration of settings including
Waddles configuration (color, accessories, etc.)
Privacy settings configuration

li.span:
These are controlled via a browser-based, CLI-based, or application-based program
leveraging Kerberos or OIDC for seamless usage.
This server writes to a special labmap Organizational Unit in the OCF LDAP.
Saving of custom art is TBA.
